submission.justification: PROVISIONAL, NOT VALIDATED. No candidate in candidate_specs.md has a stated Level-1 latency (0 of 3 stated; all 3 flagged as unstated), so none can be shown to meet the 4.0 us hard limit. No simulations were run (simulations_run = 0), so there is no measured signal efficiency or trigger rate for this signature, and the 8 kHz allocation is unchecked. Algorithm-L3 is chosen only as the highest-efficiency option in the legacy 2025 reference (92% at 35 GeV vs. 85% for L2 and 74% for L1). That reference is from a different context and does not establish performance for the new signature. The 35 GeV threshold is a mid-range placeholder inside the 20-60 GeV window, not a rate-tuned value. This recommendation should not be deployed until (1) the latency of each candidate is measured on L1 FPGA hardware and confirmed at or below 4.0 us, (2) the rate at each threshold is simulated against the 8 kHz allocation, and (3) signal efficiency is computed for the new signature. If L3 fails the latency check, the choice should move to the fastest candidate that passes.
